chunks: And 'Āṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who says to another man, "I will buy merchandise for you, and the profit will be between me and you." He said: "There is no harm in it."

key_terms.الرِّبْحُ: the profit gained from the transaction
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam for one person to buy goods for another and share the profit?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting an arrangement in which one person purchases merchandise for another and the profit is shared between them. It indicates the permissibility of this kind of cooperative commercial agreement in principle.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3793 - Asim bin Humayd narrated from Abu Basir:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who says to another man, "I will buy merchandise for you, and the profit will be shared between me and you."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
